verdict.rationale: A government online filing portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes natural-language command operation: the docs cover conventional web forms, mail and in-person filing, and the probes show no llms.txt, no markdown docs, no OpenAPI spec, and bot-management walls on the portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
